title: Rows a Gold-Tier Update Would Touch
statement: The `customers` table has columns id, name, total_spent, tier. Suppose we were about to run `UPDATE customers SET tier = 'gold' WHERE total_spent > 1000`. Since this grader can only run SELECT statements, write a SELECT query that returns `id, name` for exactly the rows that UPDATE would affect, ordered by id.
hints: Translate the UPDATE's WHERE clause directly into your SELECT's WHERE clause
total_spent > 1000 excludes a row where total_spent is exactly 1000
